shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
horizontal register bands dividing the field
row of repeated small motifs along a band
small vessel or object placed near a figure
justification: Both are low-relief upright slabs organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a band of repeated small signs separating figural zones, and both include figures with a small object/vessel beside them. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows animals (quadrupeds in profile, a long-necked bird, a crouching predator) and abstract crouching creatures, while B shows two seated human figures facing one another across offerings above two lines of repeated sign-like characters; postures, subjects and rendering conventions do not correspond.
